reuse.why: Routes every server-side midpoint copy (schedule-template, forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview, API model) through the existing getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes five inline midpoint/dispatch copies and adds no new ones; the tolerance is not re-derived.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the other schedule helpers; the API layer only maps the result into a list-specific type.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule, its callers, the API field, docs and tests; two release notes for successive steps and a docs description left stale ('furthest from zero') are minor noise.

maintainability.why: One definition handles missing, single, approximate and ranged amounts, but the approximate rule depends on an optional loosely typed amountOp that the desktop-client callers (Balance, SchedulesTable, mobile list) do not pass, so they silently use a different rule.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gained an optional amountOp: string parameter and an isapprox branch; the client callers that omit it get the old single-amount behaviour, though no call site re-implements the rule.
